content:
Together with some colleagues, we are considering formalizing Milnor's book on hypersurface singularities. It relies heavily on considering multivariate polynomials as (complex) differentiable functions ℂⁿ → ℂ, and also as smooth maps ℝ²ⁿ → ℝ².

I have taken a look at the mvPolynomial code in mathlib, and, while it has several properties for them, I find nothing close to what we need.

Am I missing something? Or is mathlib missing that?.

file#Analysis/Analytic/Polynomial seems to have nice things, but perhaps what you need is a version of docs#MvPolynomial.evalₗ that returns a docs#ContinuousLinearMap instead of docs#LinearMap
(because of docs#ContinuousLinearMap.differentiable and friends)

I also think we're missing docs#Polynomial.deriv for docs#MvPolynomial.pderiv

Snir Broshi said:

perhaps what you need is a version of docs#MvPolynomial.evalₗ that returns a docs#ContinuousLinearMap instead of docs#LinearMap
(because of docs#ContinuousLinearMap.differentiable and friends)

This doesn't sound right. The linearity of the map is in terms of the mvpolynomials, not the argument you're evaluating it at. Making this continuous wouldn't really help with differentiability in the argument.
